name: Pane marks
responsibility: The marks a pane draws beside or over a picture, finished, without the core: the key's samples of a line, of its emphasis and traffic and of a standing pin, and the warning a code finding raises
description: markSample takes a closed union of samples and warningMark a place; both answer finished markup. Their inks, sizes and markup are generated from the core's painter by bun run build:core, so a pane holds no copy of the painter's rules: it places the markup this module finishes (TASK-653.16).
